title: Convert Case
description: Change the letter case of text values.

parameters.name: input
parameters.description: Name, index, or list of input columns.

parameters.name: output
parameters.description: Name or list of output columns. If omitted, each input column is overwritten.

parameters.name: case
parameters.description: Letter case to apply. Sentence case lowercases the value and capitalizes sentence starts.

parameters.name: where
parameters.description: Filter rows before applying the wrangle using SQL-like criteria, such as `column1 = 123 OR column2 = 'abc'`.

parameters.name: where_params
parameters.description: Values used with `where` for parameterized criteria. Uses SQLite placeholder syntax such as `?` or `:name`.

parameters.name: if
parameters.description: Condition that determines whether the wrangle runs as a whole. Recipe variables may be referenced with `${variable}`.

examples.title: Write uppercase text to a new column
examples.recipe:
wrangles:
  - convert.case:
      input: product
      output: product_upper
      case: upper

guidance:
Use `convert.case` to normalize capitalization while keeping the source column
or writing the result to a new column.

## Behavior

- Supported modes are `lower`, `upper`, `title`, and `sentence`.
- Omitting `output` overwrites the input column.
- Input and output lists must have equal lengths.
- Non-string values are passed through unchanged and produce a warning.
